geometryPolicy: Reuse the archived editable model exactly. Change only material slots and procedural surface shaders; no object, mesh, modifier, transform, camera or light changes.

buildings.name: 近代侦察营地
buildings.materialDirection: 灰米砖墙、灰绿金属屋面、暗钢瞭望架、卡其补给包；保留主厅、单塔、梯子、补给棚与罗盘。

buildings.name: 近代军营
buildings.materialDirection: 低饱和棕灰砖墙、灰石压顶、钢制门面、卡其军旗；保留中央拱门、对称双塔、城垛及原有旗形。

buildings.name: 近代靶场
buildings.materialDirection: 灰砖围墙、灰蓝金属棚顶、暗钢立柱、保留木质射击台，靶面改为米白黑环；原三靶位置不动。
buildings.sourceCaveat: Current AI-finished runtime sprite includes a roof tower absent from the archived editable model. This proposal preserves the editable source geometry; it does not claim pixel-identical geometry to the AI-finished runtime image. Existing bow and musket props are retained under the material-only scope.
